limits: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
References cover the complete Ghidra function-body AddressSet and exact entry. Dossier incoming edges omit sources owned by that function; procedure_references also retains those internal edges.
The dossier combines Ghidra FunctionManager, Listing, ReferenceManager, BasicBlockModel, and decompiler observations; provider-specific pseudocode and assembly are not cross-provider text invariants.

Resolved reference metadata identifies computed, indirect, external, call, jump, and data edges; unresolved targetless flows remain unknown, and function classifications distinguish thunks and externals.
Synthetic Ghidra entry-point references without actionable memory sources are omitted.
The Java bridge serializes one function request per Program and lets each decompilation run until it completes or the caller cancels.

Ghidra Listing reports a terminal call at 0x80639f to 0x89c9f0 __CxxThrowException@8 (external=false, thunk=false, hasNoReturn=true); fallthrough is excluded by Ghidra's flow model. This records Ghidra's FunctionManager flag, not an independent verification that the callee cannot return.
Windows Ghidra P0 accepts native x86 and x86-64 PE applications and DLLs, and explicitly selected raw 6502 images; managed, hostile, sensitive, and mutable-path targets are unsupported.
The Windows bridge uses authenticated IPv4 loopback because Node path-based IPC does not expose Java AF_UNIX sockets; the endpoint file contains no bearer token.

Windows sessions require the matching packaged Windows x64 native addon, local NTFS targets and runtimes, and Windows 10 or later. Native handles enforce path admission, private DACLs, and Job Object ownership automatically.

The target references PDB Tartaros.pdb (GUID 491a189d-6d27-43d1-a6b5-81ace6a1df8b, age (hex) 1, signature unknown, version RSDS); Ghidra reports load state unknown. Original names and types may be missing; an empty name search does not prove a procedure is absent. Use list_procedures and address-based analysis to inspect recovered functions. REA does not admit a caller-selected PDB companion.

limits: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
References cover the complete Ghidra function-body AddressSet and exact entry. Dossier incoming edges omit sources owned by that function; procedure_references also retains those internal edges.
The dossier combines Ghidra FunctionManager, Listing, ReferenceManager, BasicBlockModel, and decompiler observations; provider-specific pseudocode and assembly are not cross-provider text invariants.

Resolved reference metadata identifies computed, indirect, external, call, jump, and data edges; unresolved targetless flows remain unknown, and function classifications distinguish thunks and externals.
Synthetic Ghidra entry-point references without actionable memory sources are omitted.
The Java bridge serializes one function request per Program and lets each decompilation run until it completes or the caller cancels.
Windows Ghidra P0 accepts native x86 and x86-64 PE applications and DLLs, and explicitly selected raw 6502 images; managed, hostile, sensitive, and mutable-path targets are unsupported.
The Windows bridge uses authenticated IPv4 loopback because Node path-based IPC does not expose Java AF_UNIX sockets; the endpoint file contains no bearer token.

Windows sessions require the matching packaged Windows x64 native addon, local NTFS targets and runtimes, and Windows 10 or later. Native handles enforce path admission, private DACLs, and Job Object ownership automatically.

The target references PDB Tartaros.pdb (GUID 491a189d-6d27-43d1-a6b5-81ace6a1df8b, age (hex) 1, signature unknown, version RSDS); Ghidra reports load state unknown. Original names and types may be missing; an empty name search does not prove a procedure is absent. Use list_procedures and address-based analysis to inspect recovered functions. REA does not admit a caller-selected PDB companion.

CSquare 0014 設 controller+4，不證明資源或玩家 ready；init 內0043早於0069尾欄位，不是0014 ACK。

NPC 直接入口走本機UI，但5B9340延後確認可啟動561760(scenario,1)並送6-byte001C；不能概括為永不送001C。
QuestMgr handler5030C0為0064；(FAB5C4-FAB2A0-4)/8=0x64，與教學004C不同域，15/1 intro不等於完成。
線上報告表容量3029正確，但(FD8BA8-FD2CFC)/8=3029.5；迴圈欄位起點FD2D00才得到3029=0xBD5。
Type1 event8不是HP0/death判定；4CB2C0同時受owner+15C與+370 guard控制resource+11C，須保留上下文。
保留既有807830非零A02C失敗fallback807A70，以及checksum失敗skip-copy後共用record限制；線上摘要不覆蓋舊證據。
v7手動回報僅是相容流程觀察；窗口、Quest15及後續scene未完整驗收，AI fixture與官方原生分開。
0038 type2/6 +7預載字典key為Case.ID；Case103、STAGE19、Quest15、Map191/192不互換，004E/0028 ID仍待核對。
以0047指定quest/scene；0045依CompleteAction，不能用45/15/2代播第二段。3F早於全部清理，也不等於任務完成。
0050的可用、預選、容量、尾向量分開；mask0而保留尾向量不能宣稱空隊伍。影片候選值不等於官方抓包。
0022/type0一般結果與TUTO完成不同；非零結果分支是角色說明，非mode1確認亦可送0033，不能只接受直接分支或強制+9=0。
0038+3結果背景索引與0012 Map selector分開；PositionList結果演出資料不當玩家出生點，EmptyController ready不等於可走。
FE1A88分流與FE1AA0使用者頁碼分開，0043不是map-ready；checkpoint(type,id)尚不提供官方目的地。
T08-099以容器實參身分補正098的payload型別衝突；不能以相鄰全域、共用node+24或helper混合0x8C manager與Provider。
Knowledge base仍列全域owner未解，但129具體提出callback+0C/manager+98鏈；保留兩版與論據，不由Canonical名稱或時間戳裁決全部機器碼正確性。
同SHA報告129稱PE .text VA401000對raw400，141/152稱raw0平鋪或VA-401000；兩式差400。沒有統一來源映射前，保留候選vtable入口矛盾，不補猜指標修正、不當確定方法。
直接xref／raw DWORD零命中與特定暫存器寫入掃描不是所有間接存取或caller不存在的證明；不推UAF、不可達或排他性Server寫入。
5452C0前導000A後DWORD來源F93944有先前報告及既存快取支持；後來筆記仍稱堆疊殘值不覆蓋此依據，恆為0與credit業務名稱仍未證。
6D0B00屬loader內部，4×11是表形狀；54F270是predicate非施放，false亦有actor+3E8局部allow。Z/V映射、連段、cancel窗口與tier不由這些值補猜。
089/090/092尚未定位resource+20 reader的說法已由093保存的7BD8D0局部分支補足；不因較早或較晚檔名保留未知，也不命名動畫長度。
wrapper+20、0x7C resource+20與另一0x40配置+20分開；同offset不構成reader或型別身分證據。
binding+7C/+80獨立；+80只限制7BDF40的特定virtual+18路徑，不證所有更新停止或死亡。
096/097的0x8C manager→Provider銜接必須受098/099容器實參分離更正限制；不能把node+24通用寫入當同一heap Provider。
22*0x2004=0x2C058是相等，不是額外尾配置；桶count清零不是entries逐一清零／析構；count診斷reader不是逐項dispatch。
callback+4空方法、callback+0C consumer、entry+0C與core/interface virtual分開；重複slot數不合併receiver。
130自身明記flat碼位移與PE raw400讀到不同bytes，支持前批來源映射缺口仍未解；B top-N／context／logical reset僅保留報告候選，不宣稱型別與ABI閉合。
547240是timeGetTime差值嚴格>500的有條件狀態機，不是原生Z連段或取消窗口；不能等同0.65秒fixture。
三路返回OR與byte優先選擇不同；548918內部迴圈實際28..37而非28..39，不能認成十段普攻。
FB9004+index清零不是非零事件writer；phase1/3不直接命名keydown/keyup，負xref不證writer不存在。
SubAI計數>60不能換秒；7/9不是tier，-1 fallback與actor state分開；型別建構／註冊樹不證controller+0C為同一實例。
BND兩層查詢與bit非0表示限於保存的靜態表示；不把格clear／缺絕對writer命中推完整可達、合法spawn或writer不存在。
更早發送草稿的非零A02C只走0BBB、checksum一律discard、輸入DWORD堆疊殘值等說法不覆蓋既有精確證據：保留807830失敗fallback807A70、skip-copy共用record路徑及F93944標頭來源。
撤回將003D排除為角色切換：CTownInfoTable TYPE1與配對視窗Town路徑有依據；I1同步及官方應答仍缺。
撤回對v8既有003D切角handler的歸因；來源現讀為000C，不能聲稱修復不存在的分支。原生Town003D介面另依保存證據。
004E→0028原樣回送不要求先猜Case/STAGE/Map等價；臨時集合+8非CScenarioDescData token重設。
C2S0042/0059局部sender與S2C0042不同，007E append非覆寫；已知長度不證目的地／Map／spawn。
0099/type3→MissionRoom/kind1/UI4是局部生命週期，不等正常Town1；不採未確認C0B150候選，保留C0FA6C安裝依據。
本原件PE headers與新稿14009個byte視窗相符，舊flat標籤不能直接比PE vtable。只對確指相同raw計算-400；不全域平移entities或推完整ABI已解。
T16線上早期沒有實體Lua/XML是當時來源限制，本地選定成員已獨立重解；不是永久資訊缺失，也不代表官方server規則閉合。
Tip/TutoQuest與Shout/HasQuest等來源已獲實體互證，FE18DC不當任務進度庫；generic parser/樹向量不是backend狀態writer。
Demand鏈、local scenario14 flag、script1000/14與Quest16完成分開；QuestTalk無選定row不等提取失敗，seq劇情來源不等官方封包序列。
category4 range折半、UI/controller本地writer已具來源；cp命中不證指定輸入裝置，雇用global不等server接受。
指定carrier KeyMapping/Extra實體已取得，解除新線上缺檔限制；封包內預設不證現用自訂映射、非零phase writer或動作queue。
TC資源獨立核對，Part1與獎勵數值非純翻譯等價；相同Part2 code不推TC native API／網路／保存等價，沒有搬用KR位址。
